name: Threat Incursion
author: Tristan
description: The Threat does not stay in the abyss. Once woken, the fabricator swarms colonize the sector's fringe - founding real colonies that mine, refine, and forge for a closed hive economy - then strike outward at inhabited space, converging on the core worlds. Fight the network, not just the fleets: cut its supply chains, sabotage expeditions in fabrication, steal the Fragment Fabricators that shield hive worlds from bombardment, and burn the swarm out colony by colony. Standalone; pairs with Remnant Retribution. Configurable via LunaLib (optional).
